svg.aria-label: Network Watcher's two reactive diagnostics in four bands: the different questions connection troubleshoot and packet capture answer and their diverged prerequisites, the fault taxonomy connection troubleshoot returns, the packet capture dials and its ring buffer, and the traps in both tools.
svg.title: One tool names the fault; the other shows the packets. Only one works on a VM you did not prepare
svg.text: Two reactive tools, and the prerequisite that decides which you have at 2am
Network Watcher is enabled automatically when you create a virtual network, at no charge. The agent is not.
1 · DIFFERENT QUESTIONS, DIVERGED PREREQUISITES
Connection troubleshoot — “what is blocking this?”
AGENTLESS. Runs on Azure platform APIs.
From: VM · scale set · Bastion · App Gateway v2
To: VM · FQDN · URI · IP address · TCP or ICMP
Packet capture — “show me the bytes”
NEEDS the AzureNetworkWatcherExtension.
Virtual machines and scale sets only
Local disk or storage blob · 5-tuple filters
The agent needs outbound TCP to 169.254.169.254:80 and 168.63.129.16:8037 — and is unsupported on AKS clusters.
2 · IT DOES NOT SAY “UNREACHABLE” — IT NAMES THE FAULT
Six fault types
CPU · Memory · GuestFirewall · DNSResolution · NetworkSecurityRule · UserDefinedRoute
Routing
UserDefinedRoute (None next hop = blackhole) · UDRLoop · RouteMissing · NoRouteLearned
Peering
VnetAccessNotAllowed · AllowGatewayTransitNotEnabled · UseRemoteGatewaysNotEnabled
Appliance
IPForwardingNotEnabled · MultiNICsInSameSubnet (+ weak host variants)
Load balancer
DIPProbeDown · StandardILBOutboundInternetNotAllowed · BasicILBNotSupportedWithGlobalPeering
It is just off
Seven distinct VM power states, from VMStarting through VMDeallocated
Each issue carries Origin (Inbound / Outbound / Local), Severity (Error / Warning), and the hop it was found at.
3 · THE CAPTURE DIALS, AND THE RING BUFFER
Standard session
Continuous capture
Time limit 18,000 s (5 hours)
Time limit 86,400 s default, 604,800 s (7 days) max
Bytes per packet: all, or 34
Files: 10 default, 10,000 max
for the IPv4 header alone
Bytes per file: 100 MB default, 4 GB max
Stops on time or size
Oldest file is deleted to make room — by design
Defaults hold 10 × 100 MB = 1000 MB of recent traffic. The ceiling is 10,000 × 4 GB = 40,000 GB.
10,000 parallel sessions per region per subscription — sessions only, not the saved files.
4 · FOUR THINGS THAT WILL COST YOU AN INCIDENT
A guest firewall answers your TCP ping itself when no rule allows it — the probe never reaches the target,
and the event is not logged. A “successful” TCP ping is not proof the destination heard anything.
Packet capture signs its storage writes with SAS tokens. Disable key access on the account and captures
can only go to the VM’s local disk — a hardening setting quietly removes a diagnostic destination.
One Network Watcher per region per subscription · VPN troubleshoot runs one operation at a time.
And the AI summary is preview, Copilot-gated, available in ten regions, and documented as possibly incorrect: check it.
